verdict.rationale: Exa's docs name two official SDKs, `exa-py` (pip) and `exa-js` (npm), both reading `EXA_API_KEY` from the environment. The exa-js GitHub repo shows agent-oriented features: a `webSearch()` tool for OpenAI/Anthropic loops, `streamSearch` yielding OpenAI-style chunks, `answer()` with citations, and `outputSchema`. A downloadable OpenAPI spec also supports building custom clients. missing for 10: direct repo/usage evidence for exa-py beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
